This first v0.6 alpha opens the next development line after the v0.5 release
branch split. It packages the current `main` control plane and Portal for early
integration testing while v0.5 stabilization continues independently.

## Highlights

- Expand the Portal's responsive mobile layouts across workflows, Goobers,
  runs, work items, insights, costs, traces, logs, and diagnostics.
- Preserve compatibility with legacy v0.5 USD-denominated cost payloads while
  presenting the current AIC cost model.
- Add configuration-source discovery, document reads, portable gaggle bundle
  import/export, and configuration-repository write and pull-request actions.
- Strengthen claim retirement, recovery, handoff validation, scheduler state,
  filesystem safety, and bounded read behavior across local and remote runs.
- Extend placement, worker authorization, telemetry exporter health, and
  terminal-cause observability for distributed operation.

## Alpha boundaries

- This is an early prerelease for integration testing, not a stable v0.6
  compatibility commitment.
- The `release/v0.5` branch remains the source for v0.5 release candidates and
  stabilization fixes; this alpha intentionally follows the newer `main` line.
- Automatic installation accepts stable releases only. Download prerelease
  archives directly and verify them against `SHA256SUMS`.
